title: Mailtrap Free evaluated: mandatory TLS gate remains unmet
summary: Official Sandbox documentation supports capture, authentication and Free-plan forwarding exclusion, but describes TLS as optional. NO-GO for connection under current requirements; no external configuration or email submission.

changes.detail: Recorded product-specific pricing, TLS support versus enforcement, manual/automatic forwarding limitations, direct Resend bypass paths, synthetic validation instructions and zero-infrastructure scoped SEO alternative.

validation.name: Official documentation review
validation.detail: Current pricing lists Free $0/50 messages monthly. Both forwarding modes require Basic. Sandbox-specific official guide describes TLS as optional; no cross-product TLS guarantee assumed.

validation.name: Existing email guard tests
validation.detail: All 18 synthetic email safety tests passed; reviewed staff invitation and direct Resend paths. Candidate source/build unchanged.

validation.name: Mandatory TLS and account-effective isolation
validation.detail: No account accessed or configured; required TLS, actual plan/trial forwarding entitlements and Supabase-client fail-closed behavior not proven. No SMTP messages or hosted verifier executed.
